QUOTE: "`NavigationHeader` (`app/components/navigation_header/index.tsx`) does not use the ref itself. It forwards it to `NavigationSearch` only when `hasSearch` is true."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch, which is mounted only when `hasSearch` is true. It doesn't say outright that the ref attaches to nothing otherwise, but that follows from the conditional mounting.
